subject: [PATCH v5 1/3] mm/vmstat, mm/memcontrol: add _monotonic vmstat readers

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch adds new functions to the Linux kernel that provide monotonic, non-clamping readers for certain vmstat counters. These counters are used in situations where a snapshot of a monotonically-incremented event counter is taken and then compared to a later value. The existing clamped readers were causing issues when the underlying signed long values wrapped past LONG_MAX, resulting in incorrect deltas. The new functions return the underlying state value cast to unsigned long, ensuring that the subtraction stays correct even after a wraparound. This patch is a prerequisite for further changes to the kernel's memory management and performance monitoring systems.
